1  GOVERNMENT PLEADER- SMT VIDYA KURIAKOSE  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 10.04.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO.14193 of 2025 2  2025:KER:31417  JUDGMENT Dated this the 10th day of April, 2025

The writ petition is filed to direct the third respondent bank to lift the debit freezing of the petitioner's bank account bearing No. 50200068554066.
2.
The petitioner is the holder of the above bank account with the third respondent bank.
The petitioner's bank account has been debit frozen by the third respondent bank pursuant to the requisition received from the second respondent.

The second respondent had registered Crime No.
1238/2023 against the petitioner for allegedly committing the offences under sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

The second respondent filed the charge sheet in the crime, and the case was registered as C.C. No. 230/2024 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
Kothamangalam.

entities.text:
Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
Kothamangalam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Subsequently, the matter was settled between the parties.
By Ext. P1 order, this Court quashed the FIR and final report.
In 2025:KER:31417 view of Ext. P1 order, the freezing of the petitioner's bank account is no longer necessary.
Therefore, the third respondent may be directed to lift the freezing of the petitioner's bank account.

3. Heard; the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, the learned Government Pleader and the learned counsel for the third respondent.
4.

On a consideration of the facts and the materials on record, particularly Ext. P1 order passed by this Court whereby the final report and all further proceedings have been quashed by this Court, I am of the view that the writ petition is to be allowed.

In the afore said circumstances, I direct the third respondent bank to lift the debit freezing of the petitioner's bank account and remove the lien, if any, marked on the petitioner's bank account, if not already done.
The writ petition is ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
